During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''lieutenant''' served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Invasion of Sarrahban|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrahban]]. The [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] relayed information to the commanding [[Unidentified Imperial admiral (Sarrahban)|admiral]] regarding civilian [[Starship/Legends|starships]] attempting to escape the planet; the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] ordered all ships leaving the surface to submit to inspection, and issued orders to destroy those ships that failed to comply. The lieutenant questioned the order since the ships were civilian vessels, but the admiral threatened to relieve them of their post if the orders were not carried out.<ref name="Harvest" />
